name: Reflect
definition: Ranged hits from 2+ tiles away bounce back to the attacker.

name: Flying
definition: Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage.

name: Marked
definition: These tiles take the hit on this enemy's next turn.

name: Charge
definition: At 3 Charge it unleashes Arc Burst; Shock removes 1.

name: Gust
definition: On its beat, the wind pushes every unit downwind.

name: Bursts
definition: When it dies, it hits every unit next to it and leaves Fire.

name: Shape Ground
definition: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles.

name: Fire
definition: Entering deals 2 damage; starting a turn here deals 3.

name: Ice
definition: Units on it are Chilled.

name: Electrified
definition: Lightning hits spread across connected Electrified tiles.

name: Rubble
definition: Costs 2 movement to leave.

name: Chilled
definition: Takes 2 more damage from attacks; an Ice attack Freezes it.

name: Detonate
definition: Blow up the chosen ground, hitting everyone on and next to it, you included.

name: Expend
definition: Remove the shown ground to power this effect.

name: Relocate Ground
definition: Move a ground tile to another open tile.

name: Melee
definition: Damage an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.

name: Ranged
definition: Damage a target in Range and line of sight.

name: Pierce
definition: Ignores Block and Stoneskin.

name: Move
definition: Walk up to that many tiles.

name: Retreat
definition: Moves up to that many tiles away from its target.

name: Blink
definition: Teleport up to that many tiles to a visible open tile.

name: Range
definition: Maximum distance in tiles.

name: Block
definition: Absorbs damage until its holder's next turn.

name: Stoneskin
definition: Absorbs damage after Block; lasts until used up.

name: Heal
definition: Restore that much Health.

name: Draw
definition: Draw that many cards.

name: Card Play
definition: Each card you play spends one; they refill each turn, and kills give one more.

name: Follow-up
definition: Gain the bonus if you already played a card this turn.

name: Empower
definition: Pay the extra cost as you play this card to gain its bonus.

name: Stagger
definition: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time.

name: Time
definition: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.

name: Illusion
definition: A decoy with that much Health; enemies attack it if it's as close as you.

name: Light
definition: Lights tiles within its radius through the Umbra.

name: Vision
definition: See that many tiles farther for the shown turns.

name: Truesight
definition: Every enemy counts as visible for the shown turns.

name: Dispel Umbra
definition: Lower the Umbra by that many stages this combat.

name: Eclipse
definition: The darkest Umbra: you see only 1 tile around you.

name: Bleed
definition: Takes that much damage before each move or attack.

name: Expose
definition: Its next damaging hit takes that much more damage.

name: Sunder
definition: Strips that much Block, then Stoneskin, before damage.

name: Exhaust
definition: Leaves your deck for the rest of combat.

name: Consume
definition: Gone for the rest of the run once used.

name: Retaliate
definition: Until its next turn, whoever hits this unit up close takes that much damage.

name: Quicken
definition: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time.

name: Rite
definition: Its effect lasts the rest of combat and the card Exhausts.

name: Next Attack
definition: Your next attack this turn gains the bonus.

name: Swap
definition: Trade places with a visible enemy or your illusion.

name: Petrify
definition: Skips its next turn and gains 5 Block.

name: Cleanse
definition: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.

name: Skate
definition: This turn, Ice costs no movement and doesn't Chill you.

name: Anchored
definition: Push, Pull and Wind can't move it.

name: Fireproof
definition: This turn, Fire ground doesn't hurt you.

name: Convert Ground
definition: Turn the chosen ground into another kind, hitting enemies on it.

name: Discharge
definition: Remove a connected Electrified network, hitting enemies on and next to it.

name: Sweeping Strike
definition: Hits every visible enemy that qualifies; no target needed.

name: Swap Illusion
definition: Swap places with one of your illusions.

name: Shatter Illusion
definition: Destroy one of your illusions, hitting enemies next to it.

name: Freeze
definition: Skips its next turn and takes triple damage until then.

name: Shock
definition: On its next turn, it can only Move or Blink.

name: Immobilize
definition: Can't Move, Blink or Swap during its next turn.

name: Chain
definition: Jumps to new targets within that many tiles of each hit.

name: Push
definition: Move the target that many tiles straight away; if blocked, Collision.

name: Pull
definition: Move the target that many tiles straight closer; if blocked, Collision.

name: Collision
definition: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per tile left, to both units.

name: Health
definition: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.

name: Health Cost
definition: Lose that much Health; Block can't prevent it.

name: Area Attack
definition: Hits every foe on the red tiles, even unseen ones.

name: Lightning Strikes
definition: Strikes the marked tiles, then leaves them Electrified.

name: Summon
definition: Calls the shown enemy into the fight. When an enemy summons, you gain +1 Card Play on your next turn.

name: Raise Terrain
definition: Raises terrain that blocks movement.

name: Terrain Burst
definition: Hits units around its terrain pieces.

name: Cinder Marks
definition: Marks tiles that take damage and turn to Fire when it lands.

name: Crownfire
definition: Detonates the Fire on its last Cinder Marks, hitting everyone caught.

name: Hollow Gale
definition: Strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx and Pushes struck actors 1 tile.

name: Crystal Mantle
definition: Each layer cancels one direct hit.

name: Guard Ally
definition: Gives Block to its allies, sometimes itself.

name: Heal Ally
definition: Heals a wounded enemy, possibly itself.

name: Last Eclipse
definition: Hits anyone outside Light, then plunges the room into Eclipse.

name: Radiance
definition: Cards that push back the Umbra.

name: Embers
definition: Spent on wares and levels; dropped when you die.

name: The Run
definition: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.

name: Map and Rooms
definition: Choose your route through the section's rooms.

name: Character
definition: Your gear, magic, items and skills.

name: Rewards
definition: After combat, take 1 of 3 cards, or skip to heal 3.

name: Relics
definition: Passive effects that last the whole run.

name: Combat Board
definition: The 9×9 grid where combat happens.

name: Turn Clock
definition: The unit with the lowest Time acts next; you win ties.

name: Health and Defenses
definition: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.

name: Defiance
definition: Each charge turns a lethal hit into 25% Health.

name: Targeting
definition: Targets must be visible and in Range; ranged attacks need line of sight.

name: Fatigue
definition: Drawing from an empty pile reshuffles your discard and costs Health.

name: Traps
definition: Trigger when entered or hit, spreading their element around.

name: The Umbra
definition: Darkness that hides enemies and their intents.

name: Worldspines
definition: Stone spires that block movement but not sight.

name: Fire
definition: Fire cards place Fire ground and Detonate it.

name: Ice
definition: Ice cards place Ice and Freeze Chilled targets.

name: Lightning
definition: Lightning cards place Electrified ground and spread through it.

name: Air
definition: Air cards push, pull and move units.

name: Earth
definition: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.

name: Quick Wits
definition: Once per combat, discard a card to gain @icon(draw) 1. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Measured Breath
definition: At the end of your turn, bank 1 unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn. Wait still applies.

name: Ghost Stride
definition: Once per combat, activate to make your next free move a @icon(blink) of up to 2 tiles.

name: Discerning Eye
definition: Once between bosses, replace every card in a non-boss combat reward with new ones.

name: Rehearsed Escape
definition: Once per combat, activate to send your next non-item @icon(exhaust) card to your discard instead.

name: Makeshift Tool
definition: Once per combat, activate to send your next item to your discard instead of @icon(consume).

name: Carry the Guard
definition: Once per combat, activate while you have @icon(block): at the end of your turn, it becomes @icon(stoneskin).

name: Pain Remembers
definition: The first time each combat you lose @icon(health), the next non-item card put in your discard returns to your hand.

name: Sure-Footed
definition: Once per combat, take no damage from the first @icon(traps) that hits you.

name: Afterimage
definition: The first time each combat you @icon(blink), leave an @icon(illusion) 2 where you started.

name: Deferred Choice
definition: Skip a card reward to save 1 offered card. It replaces 1 card in your next non-boss card reward.

name: Salvager
definition: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.

name: Borrowed Time
definition: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).

name: Last Reserve
definition: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.

name: Plunderer's Step
definition: The first time each combat a card's @icon(move) or @icon(blink) collects loot, gain 1 @icon(card_play).

name: Prismatic Instinct
definition: Once per combat, place any ground on a visible tile within @icon(range) 4. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Curator's Patience
definition: After choosing a relic, save 1 unchosen relic for your next relic offer.

name: Living Shadow
definition: Once per turn, when an @icon(illusion) is removed, return your latest non-item discard to hand.

name: True Bearing
definition: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.

name: Encore
definition: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Open Arsenal
definition: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot.

name: Confluence
definition: Once per combat, @icon(surface_relocate) 1 ground tile. Both tiles must be visible, within @icon(range) 4 of you and each other.

name: Last Door
definition: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1.

name: Long Dawn
definition: Temporary @icon(illuminate), @icon(vision) and @icon(truesight) you create last 1 more turn.

name: Sunpath
definition: Once per turn, when you @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ tiles, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 for 2 turns on your path.

name: Witchlight
definition: Your @icon(illusion) give off @icon(illuminate) 1 while they last.

name: Dawnbrand
definition: Your first @icon(melee), @icon(ranged), @icon(push) or @icon(pull) hit each turn on an enemy in @icon(illuminate) applies @icon(expose) 1.

name: Afterglow
definition: When an @icon(illusion) is removed, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 for 2 turns on its tile.

name: Open Sky
definition: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(truesight).

name: Skill Point
definition: Earned by leveling; spend them on skills.

name: Moltshards
definition: Won from your first dragon; trade for Embers or reset your skills.

name: Wait
definition: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.

name: Turns
definition: How many of your turns this effect lasts.

name: Movement
definition: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.

name: Item
definition: A one-use card from your item slots.

name: Outcrop
definition: Attackable terrain that blocks movement.

name: Wildfire
definition: On its beat, each Fire tile sets the next tile in the blaze's direction on Fire.

name: Frostbite
definition: On its beat, an Ice hit strikes everyone standing on Ice, Freezing them.

name: Lightning Storm
definition: On its beat, lightning strikes every Electrified tile; some storms Chain on.

name: Upheaval
definition: On its beat, the marked tiles rise as Outcrops, throwing off whoever stands there.

name: Shadowstep
definition: On its beat, every enemy hidden in the dark Blinks toward you.
